children: United States Oil Fund disclosed that parent company Marygold entered a definitive agreement to be taken private by Madison Dearborn Partners in an all-cash transaction. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to Marygold stockholder, regulatory, and change-of-control approvals. After closing, Marygold will delist from the New York Stock Exchange, and leadership plans to refocus USCF’s business as part of a broader transformation strategy. There is no guarantee the transaction will close on the expected timeline, or at all.
: Support transformation strategy and refocus USCF’s business
